strict.description: Reduce false positives and analyst load.

min_cost.description: Cost-aware packaged reference operating point. Regenerate with scripts/train.py to refresh calibration-selected thresholds and holdout-test metrics.

lenient.description: Increase fraud capture with higher review load.

decision_contract.approve: risk_score below the selected review threshold
decision_contract.review: risk_score at or above the selected review threshold

metrics_boundary: Packaged thresholds are suitable for local review workflows; operational metrics should be regenerated on the target dataset with a separate holdout test split.
